response.what_it_is: Portable hydraulic borehole drilling machine rig with engine and pump unit
visible_condition: includes separate petrol engine and pump unit
hidden_risks: Actual drilling depth and torque capability under real soil/rock conditions
Internal quality, reliability, and pressure rating of the hydraulic pump and motor
Durability and strength of structural welds under heavy load
Inclusion or omission of essential accessories like drill rods, bits, and swivels
response.best_proof: A video demonstration of the rig operating successfully or a detailed specification sheet for the engine and hydraulic system.
seller_claims_unsupported: Capable to drill holes to your satisfaction
response.drop_reason: Brand new custom-fabricated equipment by a maker/fabricator, not a second-hand good.
response.failure_mode: AI might mistake this local custom fabrication for high-end imported industrial drilling rigs, leading to a massive overvaluation.
